services.scriptContent:
import com.edu.scnu.domain.shared.DomainException

if (!row) throw DomainException.invalidParams('包裹记录不存在')
def status = row.getStr('status')
if (status == 'PICKED' || status == 'RETURNED') {
    throw DomainException.stateGuardFailed("该包裹已出库（" + (status == 'PICKED' ? '已取走' : '已退回') + "），不能重复出库！")
}
if (status != 'READY') {
    throw DomainException.stateGuardFailed('只有“待取件”状态的包裹才能核验取件出库，请先确认上架！')
}
int d = ((row.getInt('storage_days') ?: 0) as int)
double fee = d > 3 ? (d - 3) * 1.0d : 0.0d
def operator = env.getUsername() ?: currentUser
rs.updateFromService([id: row.getId(), version: row.getInt('version'), values: [
    status: 'PICKED',
    overdue_fee: fee,
    outbound_type: 'PICKUP',
    outbound_time: now
]])
env.get('exp_outbound').createFromService([values: [
    outbound_type: 'PICKUP',
    parcel_id: row.getId(),
    tracking_no: row.getStr('tracking_no'),
    pickup_code: row.getStr('pickup_code'),
    shelf_id: row.getStr('shelf_id'),
    recipient_name: row.getStr('recipient_name'),
    recipient_phone: row.getStr('recipient_phone'),
    overdue_fee: fee,
    outbound_time: now,
    operator_name: operator,
    reason: args.reason?.toString()?.trim() ?: '收件人核验取件出库',
    status: 'COMPLETED'
]])
return JsonRpcServiceResponse.reloadWindow("取件出库成功！取件码 [" + (row.getStr('pickup_code') ?: row.getStr('inbound_no')) + "] 已核销，超期保管费：￥" + fee + "")

services.name: returnSender
services.scriptContent:
import com.edu.scnu.domain.shared.DomainException

if (!row) throw DomainException.invalidParams('包裹记录不存在')
def status = row.getStr('status')
if (status == 'PICKED' || status == 'RETURNED') {
    throw DomainException.stateGuardFailed("该包裹已出库（" + (status == 'PICKED' ? '已取走' : '已退回') + "），不能重复出库！")
}
if (!(status in ['PENDING', 'READY', 'PROBLEM'])) {
    throw DomainException.stateGuardFailed('当前包裹状态不可执行退货出库！')
}
double fee = row.getDouble('overdue_fee') ?: 0.0d
def operator = env.getUsername() ?: currentUser
def reasonText = args.reason?.toString()?.trim() ?: '滞留退回或客户拒收退货出库'
rs.updateFromService([id: row.getId(), version: row.getInt('version'), values: [
    status: 'RETURNED',
    outbound_type: 'RETURN',
    outbound_time: now
]])
env.get('exp_outbound').createFromService([values: [
    outbound_type: 'RETURN',
    parcel_id: row.getId(),
    tracking_no: row.getStr('tracking_no'),
    pickup_code: row.getStr('pickup_code'),
    shelf_id: row.getStr('shelf_id'),
    recipient_name: row.getStr('recipient_name'),
    recipient_phone: row.getStr('recipient_phone'),
    overdue_fee: fee,
    outbound_time: now,
    operator_name: operator,
    reason: reasonText,
    status: 'COMPLETED'
]])
return JsonRpcServiceResponse.reloadWindow("退货出库成功！运单 [" + (row.getStr('tracking_no')) + "] 已退回寄件人并生成出库记录")
